headline: Rajani Associates acts on Sotefin Bharat IPO

detail: Sotefin Bharat Limited has made an initial public offering of equity shares aggregating to ₹89.76 crore. Rajani Associates advised Sotefin Bharat, as well as the Book Running Lead Manager Choice Capital Advisors Private Limited, on this IPO. The Firm advised on all key legal aspects of the IPO, conducting legal and secretarial diligence; drafting, reviewing and finalizing all chapters of the DRHP, RHP and Prospectus; preparing and finalizing responses to BSE queries; assisting SBL and BRLM in the Issue; preparing and finalising all agreements; and preparing and finalising all ancillary documents.
